title: polemonium carneum subsp. genuinum
intro:
Polemonium carneum subsp. genuinum, commonly known as the Alpine Jacob's Ladder, is a flowering plant species native to the mountainous regions of the Himalayas and the Tibetan Plateau. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Polemonium carneum subsp. genuinum include pain relief, wound healing, and the treatment of respiratory issues such as bronchitis and coughs. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.

Note: More research may be needed to confirm some of the health benefits and therapeutic actions mentioned above.
